**Handlebody diagram algebras**

*Published by EMS Press and licensed under a CC BY 4.0 license*

52 pp, 8 sections.

**Abstract.** In this paper, we study handlebody versions of some classical diagram algebras, most prominently, handlebody versions of Temperley–Lieb, blob, Brauer, BMW, Hecke and Ariki–Koike algebras. Moreover, motivated by Green–Kazhdan– Lusztig’s theory of cells, we reformulate the notion of (sandwich, inflated or affine) cellular algebras. We explain this reformulation and how all of the above algebras are part of this theory.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 A generalization of cellularity; 3 Handlebody braid and Coxeter groups; 4 Handlebody Temperley–Lieb and blob algebras; 5 Handlebody Brauer and BMW algebras; 6 Handlebody Hecke and Ariki–Koike algebras; References
